title: Adversarial Tracking: Attacks on Image Sensors for Object Tracking in Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2611.17505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object tracking systems estimate the motion of surrounding vehicles by linking detected objects across video frames. In particular, Tracking-By-Detection (TBD) systems combine object detectors with motion prediction and data association to maintain object identities over time. However, neural network-based detectors are vulnerable to adversarial attacks that perturb input images, and their impact on downstream trajectory estimation is not fully characterized by detection accuracy alone. Therefore, this paper evaluates image-specific and image-agnostic attacks on YOLOv3 and YOLOv4 detectors paired with SORT, Deep SORT, Strong SORT, and OC-SORT tracking systems. The evaluation uses CARLA simulator and measures tracking quality through Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy (MOTA), Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), and Identification F1 (IDF1). Under image-specific attacks, HOTA for YOLOv3-based trackers declines from 53.45-56.19% to 14.8

translated_title: 对抗性跟踪：针对自动驾驶车辆目标跟踪的图像传感器攻击
translated_abstract: 目标跟踪系统通过在视频帧之间关联检测到的物体来估计周围车辆的运动。特别是“检测即跟踪”（Tracking-By-Detection, TBD）系统将目标检测器与运动预测和数据关联相结合，以在时间上维持物体的身份。然而，基于神经网络的检测器容易受到对输入图像进行扰动的对抗性攻击，且此类攻击对下游轨迹估计的影响无法仅通过检测精度来充分刻画。因此，本文评估了针对YOLOv3和YOLOv4检测器与SORT、Deep SORT、Strong SORT及OC-SORT跟踪系统组合的图像特定攻击和图像无关攻击。评估使用CARLA模拟器进行，并通过多目标跟踪精度（MOTA）、高阶跟踪精度（HOTA）和身份F1分数（IDF1）来衡量跟踪质量。在图像特定攻击下，基于YOLOv3的跟踪器的HOTA从53.45–56.19%下降至14.8...
tldr: 本文首次在CARLA模拟环境中系统评估了对抗性攻击对自动驾驶“检测即跟踪”系统的影响，发现图像特定攻击可使基于YOLOv3的跟踪器的HOTA指标从约54–56%骤降至约14.8%。
